fields.narrative_intro: *A bug-eyed person and an overdressed person discuss Polymarket's Jensen Huang reinstatement market on a factory floor where robots have unionized and gone on strike.*
fields.panel1:
[setup]
BUG-EYED PERSON: "The robots are striking over Polymarket's Jensen Huang reinstatement market."
OVERDRESSED PERSON: "Apparently, even wallets need a suspiciously early shift."
fields.panel2:
[build]
BUG-EYED PERSON: "New wallet: 71,517.8 YES shares for 4,648.66 USDC at $0.065."
OVERDRESSED PERSON: "Purchases ended 89 minutes before Trump's post."
fields.panel3:
[pivot]
BUG-EYED PERSON: "Trump posted: 'I hope the Board of Nvidia rehires Jensen Huang.'"
OVERDRESSED PERSON: "Then shares hit $1, earning 66,869.34 USDC—up 1,438.5%."
fields.panel4:
[silent reaction]
[Visual: The robots silently point at a factory punch clock stamped “89 MINUTES BEFORE TRUMP’S POST.”]
fields.panel5:
[punch]
OVERDRESSED PERSON: "Can investigators identify the trader?"
BUG-EYED PERSON: "No—just a wallet with perfect attendance and no diversification."
fields.panel6:
[button]
[Visual: The striking robots hold a banner reading “TRADER UNKNOWN—PUNCH CLOCK INFURIATINGLY SPECIFIC.”]

narrative_summary: A factory robot strike treats the wallet’s 89-minute head start as a labor grievance while investigators still cannot identify its owner.
rationale: Candidate 2 uses the story’s exact figures and timing to build a coherent labor-joke angle, then lands on the stronger closing contrast of a wallet with “perfect attendance and no diversification.” Candidate 1 has a workable visual premise, but “inside job” is a more predictable payoff and the recursive final image adds clutter rather than a sharper button.
story_title: Investigation of Polymarket Insider Trading on the Reinstatement of Jensen Huang
place: at a factory floor where the robots have unionized and gone on strike
hat_pair: bucket hat with googly eyes all over it
foam Rubik's cube worn as a helmet with only one face solved
